title: 1222 Ritter St, Copperas Cove, TX | Elizabeth Thomas ACE Real Estate Group | Copperas Cove, tX Homes
description:
Welcome to this charming home nestled in Copperas Cove. Boasting 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, this country chic home has a modern twist! Prepare to be wowed by the numerous updates throughout, including an updated shower/bathroom, new flooring throughout, tin backsplash in the kitchen and MORE. You will enjoy the cozy wood burning fire place! Step outside onto the Large covered back porch that has a new swing, perfect for enjoying peaceful moments or entertaining guests while enjoying the peace and quiet that Cove offers! New fencing surrounds the backyard & even have a separated area for your kids/fur babies to play! With the option to purchase most of the furniture, this cozy home could easily transition into a wonderful permanent residence or a lucrative Airbnb opportunity. Feels like you are in the country but you are still very close to shopping & dinning. Experience the comfort, style, and privacy in this very cute & inviting HOME!
-

I’m Elizabeth Thomas, your go-to 28-year-old Realtor with a passion for making dreams come true in the Lone Star State! When I’m not working for you, you can find me relaxing with my dog Tux. 🐶


In 2018 the military brought me to Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos, and it’s been an incredible journey. As a real estate professional, I’ve had the privilege of helping HUNDREDS of families find their perfect homes and navigate the exciting world of real estate. 🗝
Originally from North Carolina, I carry the warmth of Southern hospitality in my heart and the determination to go the extra mile for my clients. 💖 Whether you’re an investor seeking prime opportunities, a first-time buyer, a seller aiming to make a profitable move, or a fellow military family in need of a seamless transition, I’m here to serve and support you every step of the way. 🤝
